verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents stealth, residential proxies, and CAPTCHA-solving features in detail, but contains no published acceptable-use policy, terms-of-service excerpt, or anti-abuse guidance addressing what these stealth/automation features may or may not be used for. Community discussion raises abuse-risk concerns but this is not vendor policy.
